code.head: 5d582b70951a0cdc310806a8839a8d54819eeb19
code.method: Physical source lines, including comments and blank lines, with the existing /build source filter. JSON, lockfiles, binaries, vendored/minified code, public assets and client archives are excluded by that policy. Generated compatibility templates/SQL and verification/tooling are separated. Renames count as deletion plus addition. This is change volume, not completed migration percentage or performance.
code.caveat: Original JavaScript remains until final cutover. Added Rust is staged implementation, not evidence that equivalent legacy lines have already been removed. Since-start totals also contain upstream feature work; the integration-base diff isolates the current branch contribution.

usage.method: Unique per-response token_usage_record entries in the root chat, from the explicit Rust request to the report request. Cumulative/event copies are excluded. Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning is a subset of output, never added twice.
limitations: Local root-chat telemetry, not an invoice or guaranteed complete account usage.
Model metadata is recorded; billing service tier and plan allocation are unavailable.
Earlier site/video tasks and this article-page build are excluded. Child-chat/provider usage, if any, is not included.
Repeated context counts again as input; most was cached. These are not unique words or source-code lines.

measurements.head: d47c48bc4826f7931cb2b4c38a8733c3fdb8da7d
measurements.method: Same built HTML/assets, same local API fixtures, paired alternating legacy JS vs current Rust/WASM bridges. One unrecorded warmup per route/profile. Cold-context means fresh browser HTTP/storage context, not a cold browser process or serverless start; warm reload retains that context. Static assets use HTTP cache/ETags and Brotli quality 4. CSP blocks external requests; no third-party analytics/embeds, real providers or mutations. Returning-visitor gate cookie and explicit analytics refusal. Ready means search/directory usable or CV interactions mounted. Action is a synthetic DOM event to two animation frames, not field INP. LCP/CLS are bounded lab observations, not real-user percentiles.
limitations: Only listed page flows are measured; not a whole-site pass.
API/Redis, serverless cold starts, real-network CDN regions and field INP remain separate release gates.
Timing is local and hardware-specific. Fewer than 20 repetitions are exploratory; no release speedup claim.
The test bridge currently loads one combined WASM bundle; this is not the final split publishing architecture.

problems: Exploratory sample: at least 20 repetitions per condition are required for a release comparison.
gate.note: A lab pass is necessary, not sufficient: server/API percentiles, observed cold starts, consent-aware field metrics, full route/user-flow coverage and rollback still need release evidence.
